item.title: CVE-2026-125926 - Server-side request forgery in the server registration and update API in mcp-gateway-registry
item.description: [Cloud] AWS Security: Bulletin ID: 2026-180-AWS Publication Date: 11/11/2026 13:00 PM PST Description: MServer-side request forgery (SSRF) in the server registration and update API in Amazon mcp-gateway-registry before 1.35.0 might allow an authenticated remote user to send requests from the gateway to internal network services and cloud instance metadata endpoints and read the responses via a crafted request Impacted versions: >= v1.0.3 AND <= 1.34.0 Refer to the article for the most up-to-date and complete information.

item.title: CVE-2026-100307 - Missing authorization on the external management API in mcp-gateway-registry enables privilege escalation to registry administrator
item.description: [Cloud] AWS Security: Bulletin ID: 2026-179-AWS Publication Date: 11/11/2026 12:30 PM PST Description: Missing authorization in the external management API in Amazon mcp-gateway-registry 1.0.9 through 1.24.7 might allow an authenticated remote user to assign the registry administrator scope to their own identity group and obtain administrative control of every registered gateway asset via a crafted group import request. Impacted versions: >= 1.0.9 AND <= 1.24.7 Refer to the article for the most up-to-date and complete information.

item.title: CVE-2026-124848 - Incorrect default permissions on session transcripts and prompt history in Kiro CLI
item.description: [Cloud] AWS Security: Bulletin ID: 2026-178-AWS Publication Date: 11/10/2026 12:00 PM PST Description: Incorrect default file permissions in Kiro CLI before version 2.27.0 on macOS and Linux might allow other local users on the same host to read a user's session transcripts and prompt history, including any credentials or source code they contain. The CLI created its local session storage files with permissions that made them readable by all local users. Impacted versions: Kiro CLI >= 1.16.0 AND < 2.27.0 Refer to the article for the most up-to-date and complete information.

item.title: CVE-2026-125271 - AWS API MCP Server Security Policy Bypass via Incorrect Operation Name Normalization
item.description: [Cloud] AWS Security: Bulletin ID: 2026-176-AWS Publication Date: 11/10/2026 08:30 AM PST Description: We identified CVE-2026-125271 of AWS API MCP Server. The server normalized operation names incorrectly before comparing them to the operator ' s security policy, so operations whose names contain consecutive capital letters never matched a correctly written denyList or elicitList entry. This might allow an actor to execute AWS API operations that the operator's security policy was configured to deny or require elicitation for. Impacted versions: >= 0.2.13 AND < 1.5.1 Refer to the article for the most up-to-date and complete information.
